name: UI Design Samples
summary: Shared, read-only spreadsheet listing websites as UI design samples, each with a design-signature and animation-style note.
description: A publicly shared, view-only Google Sheet of website samples used as UI design references. Columns are name, url, design_signature and animation_style; the rows cover studio, SaaS and crypto sites as well as template links, and about 30 of the numbered rows carry content.
contains: about 30 filled rows in a list numbered to 100
notes describe palette and layout, e.g. linear.app dark canvas #010102 with lavender accent #5e6ad2
entries include a16zcrypto.com, metamask.io, katana.network, linear.app, lusion.co, locomotive.ca, aino.agency
some rows are bare URLs: Behance galleries, Framer and Webflow templates
shared read-only (view only); no sign-in needed to read
